title: Capture
description: A piece of media. capture_surface is what decides the tier ceiling, so it is recorded here and nowhere else.

capture_mode.description: live means the frame was grabbed from an active camera stream on this device. An uploaded file says nothing about when or where it was made, so it can never support a stronger class than a claim.

capture_surface.description: browser cannot reach the measured class: no pairing, no attestation, and its sensors are supplied by the person being verified.
